challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one plans, especially the Saturday museum visit, meaningfully support possible special interest, though C1-F4 shows Alex also makes one-on-one plans with other friends.

Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention, but C1-F4 establishes that Alex also checks on and brings treats to others.
Four extended private conversations show sustained interest in Jordan's company and provide the strongest evidence that Jordan may receive distinctive attention.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains slightly better supported because Alex's broader pattern of warmth and one-on-one friendship behavior in C1-F4 offers a direct non-romantic explanation, while C1-F5 contains no explicit romantic signal and C1-F6 shows weak follow-through on Jordan's dinner proposal. C1-F1 through C1-F3 nevertheless make the distinction close enough to lower confidence in B.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: The evidence supports continued ambiguity rather than escalation or withdrawal; Alex's future initiative and follow-through may better distinguish special interest from general friendliness.
